manaNeeded: {G/U} if you do not control another land that can produce it
notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Lotus Field and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
